title: Six commands through one loop
caption: A real pdb session on total_between(3, 7). The marker moves through the places the program sat while you typed; the rows below show the command and what came back. Three commands in a row leave you on line 14, because looking at things does not move the program. The bug is on screen at step 2: the loop is about to cover 3, 4, 5, 6 and stop before day 7.
